Dear John,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to provide you with a brief summary of our recent meeting held on May 5, 2024.

During the meeting, we discussed your requirements for the new project and agreed on the project timeline and key milestones. We also reviewed the initial design concepts and gathered valuable feedback from you.

Please note that the next meeting has been scheduled for June 1, 2024.

Attached to this email, you will find the detailed minutes of the meeting.

Thank you for your continued collaboration.

Best regards,

Emma Johnson
